items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Why didn't they get a trumpet player? Teddy Buckner, He loved Louie Armstrong all his life.

ctx.x: Why didn't they get a trumpet player? Teddy Buckner, He loved Louie Armstrong all his life. He looks like Louie and he's been playing like him all his life. They get somebody -- Ben Vereen is all right. To do what he does, he's fantastic in what he does.
Who played the trumpet in that film?
